meta.source: Coded from the published QP and mark scheme (J560/04, Thursday 15 May 2025). Derived metadata only — question numbers, marks and skill tags. No exam question text transcribed.
meta.note: Higher partner of J560/01. 100 marks, read from the [N] part markers in the QP margin.

coding_notes: TIER CROSSOVER: q1, q2, q4, q5, q8 and q9 are the same questions as J560/01 q18, q19, q21, q23, q25 and q29. Marks match item for item and the tags are identical in both files. Unlike Edexcel's contiguous block, OCR's shared questions are INTERLEAVED with new ones — q3, q6 and q7 sit between them and appear only here.

q13a (why a quadrilateral with the centre as a vertex is not cyclic) tagged parts_of_a_circle, not circle_theorem_cyclic_quadrilateral: the answer is that O is not on the circumference, which is circle vocabulary rather than the opposite-angles theorem, and parts_of_a_circle costs no prerequisites.

q15 (y inversely proportional to the square of x) tagged proportion_with_powers, which credits 13 skills. inverse_proportion alone would not capture the square, and proportion_with_powers is the exact node.

q23b (value of x giving the smallest value of a squared bracket) tagged completing_the_square rather than quadratic_functions: reading a minimum straight off a completed square is that node's content, and it credits five skills against nine.
q11 (two function machines equal for one input and in a 2:1 ratio for another) tagged simultaneous_equations + function_machines — the machines are the vehicle, the algebra is the demand.
q16 is all four parts of one growth-and-decay model; q16c(ii), asking why the model might fail, is tagged the same way since criticising the model is part of that skill.

q21a RETAGGED to gradient_of_a_curve (was kinematic_graphs (loose: chord gradient, no motion)) when that skill was added to data/skills.ts. The audit had flagged this row as a taxonomy gap; it is no longer one.
q21b RETAGGED to gradient_of_a_curve (was untagged (tangent gradient)) when that skill was added to data/skills.ts. The audit had flagged this row as a taxonomy gap; it is no longer one.
q5a RETAGGED to equations_and_identities (was expanding_double_brackets) when that skill was added to data/skills.ts. The audit had flagged this row as a taxonomy gap; it is no longer one.
